cpa.title: CPA Management
cpa.description: Manage CLIProxyAPI connections and view synchronized credential quotas.
cpa.instance.description: AxonHub validates the connection by reading CPA auth files before saving URL or key changes.
cpa.instance.name: Instance name
cpa.instance.urlHint: HTTP(S), localhost, private-network addresses, and path prefixes are supported.
cpa.instance.secretHint: The key is encrypted for scheduled access and is never returned by the API after saving.
cpa.instance.secretPreserve: Leave blank to keep the saved key
cpa.instance.enabledHint: Disabling retains synchronized snapshots and stops network requests.
cpa.instance.autoRefreshHint: Synchronize credential info from the CPA server on this instance's schedule.
cpa.instance.insecureTLSHint: Only use for a trusted CPA endpoint with a certificate you cannot validate normally.
cpa.instance.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes {{name}} and all locally synchronized credential and quota snapshots.
cpa.empty.title: No CPA connections
cpa.empty.description: Register a CLIProxyAPI instance to synchronize its auth-file credentials and quota snapshots.
cpa.warnings.externalHTTP: This is an external HTTP address. The CPA management key will be sent without transport encryption; prefer HTTPS unless this is a trusted private or Docker network.
cpa.instance.secretRequiredForURLChange: Enter a new management key when changing the CPA address.
cpa.warnings.insecureTLS.title: TLS certificate verification is disabled
cpa.warnings.insecureTLS.description: This makes the CPA management key and responses vulnerable to interception. Confirm that the endpoint and network are trusted.
cpa.warnings.insecureTLS.confirm: I understand the risk and want to save this connection with certificate verification disabled.
cpa.warnings.insecureTLS.active: This connection currently skips certificate verification. Network traffic can be intercepted by an attacker on the path.
cpa.warnings.oldVersion.title: Older CPA version
cpa.warnings.oldVersion.description: CPA {{version}} is below the recommended minimum 7.1.0. Credential listing is available, but some provider quota capabilities may be unsupported.
cpa.warnings.connection.title: CPA connection is abnormal
cpa.warnings.connection.description: The latest credential synchronization failed. Existing snapshots are retained and marked stale.
cpa.messages.credentialRefreshedCooling: Quota data refreshed, but the credential is currently exhausted or cooling down
cpa.messages.credentialRefreshedDisabled: Quota data refreshed; the credential remains disabled
cpa.instance.autoManageHint: Patrol credentials automatically: disable exhausted or expired ones and re-enable disabled ones once their quota recovered.
cpa.instance.usageStreamHint: Continuously collect request usage through CPA's Management HTTP usage queue to estimate Codex quota value; HTTP reverse proxies are supported. History starts when collection is enabled, and outage recovery is limited by CPA queue retention. Requires usage-statistics-enabled in CPA.
cpa.instance.enabledPatrolIntervalHint: Whole minutes from 1 to 1440. Default: 5. Each run refreshes quotas of enabled credentials.
cpa.instance.patrolIntervalInvalid: Enter whole minutes within the allowed range.
cpa.instance.disabledPatrolIntervalHint: Whole minutes from 60 to 10080. Default: 480 (8 hours). Each run re-checks disabled credentials for recovery.
cpa.credential.enableDescription: This re-enables {{name}} on the remote CPA server.
cpa.credential.disableDescription: This disables {{name}} on the remote CPA server. It will be re-enabled automatically once its quota recovers.
